integrity: The general lower bound follows from the proved rank-core and disjoint-witness lemmas; reproducible finite enumeration is supplementary only. The motivating source already supplies the upper bound and lower-bound instances at three parameter values. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved for arbitrary finite normal Kripke frames and this particular pair of variable-free formulas. It is not asserted for serial/reflexive frames, arbitrary modal formula pairs, or general countermodel-size bounds. Related older alternation-rank results could provide equivalent prior coverage.
title: Sharp \(2m+2\)-world threshold for modal box–diamond iterations
